rows.en: ..."Higher-ups"? Wasn't Arche working for The O?
..."Higher-ups"? What on earth does that mean?
So that means Arche wasn't working for The O after all.
..."Higher-ups"? What does that mean?
Tch... That guy sure is quick to run away.
...Looks like someone's still pulling the strings behind this.
...Looks like someone's still pulling the strings behind this.
...Looks like someone's still pulling the strings behind this.
...Looks like someone's still pulling the strings behind this.
...Looks like someone's still behind all this, Ankh.
...Looks like someone's still behind all this.
...Looks like someone's still pulling the strings behind this.
...It seems someone is still behind all this, Ankh.
...Looks like someone's still pulling the strings behind this.
Hey, forget about that. We're heading back to base, now.
Yeah, you're right.
Yeah, you're right.
Yeah, you're right.
Yeah, you're right.
Oh, right. We should.
Yeah, let's.
Yeah! You got it!!
...You're right!!
You're right!
{8074} and the others rescued RX and headed for the base.
Apart from 00, Wing Zero and Seravee, the members of Celestial Being
stayed inside the Cube to continue the operation to take its unsecured areas.
As soon as they arrived at the base, RX went straight into the medical room.
So this is your base...
This place seems to exist independently of the other Cubes.
That's about the size of it.
And every facility that got absorbed into it is something useful to us...
Why on earth would that be...?
Alongside exploring the Cubes, I've also been investigating the base itself.
We should get to the bottom of the mystery sooner or later.
By the way, did you learn anything from striking their headquarters?
...I see. That's certainly worrying. Arche Gundam's last words...
Whoever he meant by "higher-ups," it apparently isn't The O...
So there's a mastermind in another Cube, after all?
That's the natural conclusion.
Everyone...!!
RX!! Are you all right now!?
Yeah, I can move well enough now.
Besides, I can't just lie around in bed when Rider 1 and Rider 2 need saving.
Right. Our top priority now is rescuing those two.
If I remember right, it was the "Hideout Cube," wasn't it?
That must be the Cube where they concentrate on experiments and modification...
Yeah. The enemy said something like they'd "re-modify" them...
...That settles it.
But hey, how do we even get to that Cube?
We should be able to find it by exploring the Ride Dungeon.
But it's walls everywhere in there. Was there even anywhere we could explore?
Heh...
What?
I had a feeling something like this might come up...
So I fitted the Ride Machine with the "Pelucidar Drill" you guys brought back.
With it, you should be able to break through the Ride Dungeon's walls.
Hikari...!! That's awesome!!!
We can always count on you!
I can't guarantee there's a Cube beyond those walls, but it may open up a path.
...This is one creepy-looking place.
Looks like some kind of research facility.
It seems to be some kind of research facility...
Looks like some kinda research facility.
It seems to be some kind of research facility... Is this the Crisis Empire...!?
It seems to be some kind of research facility...
Looks like some kind of research facility, all right.
Looks like some kind of research facility.
Looks like some kind of research facility.
Looks like some kind of research facility.
Whoa! What's this?
Hm? What the heck is this?
Hm? What the hell is THIS!!
Hm? What is this!?
Hm? What is this...!?
Hm? What is this...!?
Hm? What is this...!?

notes.note: #0.164-0.172 are 9 partner-variant slots of one reaction (slot 1 = Zero, labelled); this slice holds slots 6-9. 'Higher-ups' echoes Arche Gundam's line in story_042 #0.161 (untranslated when this was written); align if 042 picks another word (e.g. 'bigwigs').
Polite slot 8 (Mebius, who calls Ankh with -san in #0.181); 'So that means' draws a conclusion from Arche's remark rather than asking.

#0.174-0.182 and #0.184-0.192 are the same 9 partner slots. Voiced by register: slot 5 (#0.178/#0.188) casual and addresses Ankh by name (OOO-like), slot 6 casual, slot 7 (#0.190) loud and gung-ho, slot 8 (#0.181/#0.191) polite Mebius ('-san' dropped per style). Speakers otherwise unconfirmed.
Ankh brushing the question aside; the variants that follow agree with him.
Read as 'oh right, I nearly forgot' (aa, sou datta); rendered 'Oh, right. We should.' so it still agrees with Ankh.
Name variable plus padding: tag only. Source says just 'RX' here (the 0912 parallel says 'Black RX'); kept 'RX'.
#0.196-0.197 are one sentence cut across two rows; English cut at the matching point.

Base-scene speakers taken from work/source/speakers.json (listed under the 0912 script, but the ids match these 0256 rows; the slice file shows them as missing): Seravee #0.200-201/203-204/211/213/220/224, Nu Gundam #0.202/218, Hikari #0.205/207/210/212/215/226/228-230/233, RX #0.214/216-217/221, W (Shotaro) #0.219/222, Zero #0.223/225/227/231, W (Philip) #0.232. Content fits every label.
No speaker entry; continues Hikari's #0.205 (the 0912 parallel puts both in one box).
Labelled Hikari; a 'so after all...?' question that Seravee answers in #0.213.
'tame ni mo' rendered 'Besides... when they need saving'; subject 'I' restored.
Stock line 'sonna koto mo arou ka to' (I prepared for just this); #0.229 continues it with 'So I fitted...'.
'Pelucidar Drill': Pelucidar is the Ultra Guard drill tank from Ultraseven (established English spelling). Not in glossary; must match the item name in the system pass.
Labelled W (Philip) but uses the rough 'ze' ending; kept as short praise of Hikari that suits either half of W.

#0.2-0.10 are 9 leader/partner variants answering Ankh. #0.2 is labelled Wing Zero but its soft 'da ne' does not fit Heero; voiced neutrally. #0.5 suspects the Crisis Empire, so it is RX's slot; #0.4 rough, #0.6 polite.

Labelled Wing Zero, but the startled childlike 'waa!' (and its follow-up in story_044 #0.12) does not fit Heero; label likely shifted. #0.1-0.10 are variant slots running into story_044; #0.3 is the rough slot (Momotaros-like).

report: 80/80 rows. Base-scene speakers (0256 #0.200-0.233) recovered from speakers.json under the 0912 script. Partner-variant slots voiced by register. 0301 #0.2 and 0308 #0.1 'Wing Zero' labels don't fit Heero. 'Higher-ups' must match story_042 #0.161. Not in glossary: 'Pelucidar Drill'.
